profile.name: Artyom Nazaryan
profile.bio: I'm Artyom, a 20-year-old software engineer with 8+ years of coding experience. I primarily focus on Python development, specializing in deep learning (DL) and computer vision (CV), but I also have a strong mobile development background leveraging Kotlin and Java. My competitive programming journey includes accolades from academic competitions and olympiads, complemented by experience in big data analysis hackathons.
